lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

Ábrego García, a Salvadoran mistakenly deported by U.S., goes to Spain but hopes to return after Trump, The Associated Press reports.
A crash involving a fuel tanker has ignited a massive fire on a major highway surrounding Cairo, killing at least 31 people, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
